protocol.solverPath: real sequential production solveLevel ladder under one strict whole-solve work cap
protocol.observerEffect: phase observer reads the precomputed conditioned map at the distance seam; capacity observer scans the already-computed reached set. Neither observer output is consumed by solver policy and no observer work is charged as canonical search work.

liveRivals: phase-conditioned distance has material incremental decision-bearing opportunity
scalar distance plus current parity handling already captures practically all opportunity at this seam
resolutions.discriminatingObservable: incrementalPhaseReject=true while scalarDistanceWouldReject=false at the real distance-prune seam

outcomeInterpretation.positive: non-trivial incremental incidence nominates stored-prefix replay, differential soundness checking, then the smallest consumer
outcomeInterpretation.negative: near-zero incremental incidence with a resolution-ready envelope stops this static conditioned-distance form
outcomeInterpretation.indeterminate: any blocked required axis prevents a negative interpretation

opportunity.reason: scalar distance passed on observed phase evaluations, so the conditioned bound had room to disagree

reach.reason: phase observer reached at least one eligible solve

measurementSupport.reason: observers sit on the exact production decision seams and have synthetic incremental witnesses in solver tests

fidelity.reason: real sequential production solveLevel ladder; no ablation/profile changes; strict whole-solve work cap

coverage.reason: all eligible selected levels completed without deadline/error

censoring.reason: no eligible phase rows were deadline-truncated or errors

resolutions.negativeInterpretationPolicy: A near-zero incremental incidence is interpretable only when every required observability axis is satisfied; otherwise the result is observability-blocked, not a clean negative.
